name: web-dimmed-group-workout-photo-with-flowing-lines-and-serif-line
title: Group-exercise photo darkened with fine wavy lines and a single serif sentence
whatItIs: A photograph of people mid-workout outdoors from behind, darkened with an overlay. Thin white wavy lines run across the frame, and the centred sentence 'From health signals to everyday life.' is set in a light serif.
whatItMeans: Human and reflective; the lines suggest data flowing through everyday activity.
techniques: Darken a candid action photo for legible type.
Trace fine data-like lines over the image.
Use a single serif sentence as the only text.
Crop from behind so faces stay anonymous.
bestFor: Quote or mission slides over photography

vocabulary.definition: Fine curves drawn over a photo to suggest signals.
A dim layer over an image.
A hero with one sentence of text.
A shot from behind that hides identity.
